title: oncidium uribei
intro: Oncidium uribei, commonly known as the orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oncidium uribei include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Oncidium uribei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
